# RemoteAbility CIC

> RemoteAbility CIC is a UK Community Interest Company based in Preston, Lancashire, that supports homeless, disabled and neurodivergent people, and people recovering from addiction, through a four-stage Pathway to Independence: Safe, Stable, Ready, Independent. RemoteAbility provides active, person-centred navigation and advocacy — not just signposting — to help people access housing, recovery, benefits and employment services, culminating in a free Six-Week Pathway to Independence training programme covering digital skills, AI tools and self-employment support, leading to employment, freelancing, self-employment or business ownership.

RemoteAbility CIC does not provide emergency accommodation or clinical rehabilitation directly. It helps people access the right services, complete referrals and applications, overcome barriers, and remain supported throughout their journey towards housing, recovery, work and independence.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/): Overview of the Pathway to Independence and how to get support, refer someone, or partner.
- [Our Pathway](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/programmes.html): The four-stage model — Safe, Stable, Ready, Independent — with full detail on what RemoteAbility does at each stage.
- [I Need Support](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/support.html): For people who are sleeping rough, at risk of homelessness, or in crisis right now. Includes emergency contact numbers and a request-support form.
- [Refer Someone](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/refer.html): For professionals, support workers, family and friends referring someone to RemoteAbility.
- [Training & Work](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/training.html): Overview of the free Six-Week Pathway to Independence Programme.
- [Stage One: Safe and Stable](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/stage-safe-and-stable.html): Weeks 1-2 — needs assessment, housing support, and choosing a progression route.
- [Stage Two: Ready and Skilled](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/stage-ready-and-skilled.html): Weeks 3-4 — confidence, routine, digital skills, and pathway-specific skills-building.
- [Stage Three: Work and Independence](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/stage-work-and-independence.html): Weeks 5-6 — real-world job applications, sales and customer outreach, an AI toolkit, and a ninety-day progression plan.
- [Partner With Us](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/employers.html): For employers, referral partners (councils, charities, housing providers), and funders/commissioners. Current employment partners include Heimdell Tech AI (Sales & Business Development roles) and GreenFix Exterior Care (exterior maintenance roles), who hire graduates of the Pathway to Independence Programme.
- [About Us](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/about.html): Mission, team, values, and what a Community Interest Company (CIC) is.
- [Success Stories](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/success-stories.html): Real outcomes from participants who completed the programme.
- [Apply](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/apply.html): Application form for the Six-Week Pathway to Independence Programme.
- [Contact](https://www.remoteability.org.uk/contact.html): General enquiries, response times, and safeguarding contact.
